lead: A ratio guard's "is the machine free" probe must run on the CPUs the measured code is pinned to.
body: Worker cores are pinned (`nvs_host::worker`'s `start_one` takes `cpus()[n]`) and an unpinned control thread is not, so under a loaded sweep the control finds idle CPUs elsewhere, reads the machine as free, and the guard blames the code for load on the pinned CPUs. Pin the control with `nvs_host::pin_current_thread` to the same CPUs, as `plain_thread_fan_out` does.
